
 Usage: root admin [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Curation and admin commands

   Options
  --help          Show this message and exit.

   Commands
  pending             List datasets awaiting curation.
  approve             Approve a dataset for publication.
  reject              Reject a dataset and return to submitter.
  delete              Soft-delete a submission (curator-only).
  stats               Show admin statistics (curator-only).
  embedding-status    Show embedding coverage and snapshot info (curator-only).
  rebuild-embeddings  Generate missing dataset embeddings and rebuild the semantic-search
                      snapshot.
